teacherPage.title: Quizzes
teacherPage.subtitle: 8 question types — graded automatically and instantly.
teacherPage.deleteDialogDescription: "{{title}}" and its attempts will be deleted.

createDialog.title: New quiz
createDialog.description: 8 question types — graded automatically and instantly.
createDialog.existingTitlesAria: Open the list of existing quizzes
createDialog.copyDone: Copied {{count}} questions from "{{title}}" — edit them and save as a new quiz
createDialog.copyConfirm: Your current questions will be replaced with the ones from "{{title}}". Continue?

validation.pointsInvalid: points must be a whole number from 1 to 100
validation.markAtLeastOneCorrect: mark at least one correct answer
validation.numericAnswerInvalid: the answer must be a number
validation.toleranceInvalid: tolerance must be a non-negative number
validation.textAnswerRequired: add at least one correct answer
validation.blankRequired: the text needs at least one {{syntax}} blank
validation.blankAnswerRequired: write an answer inside every blank

createDialog.googleLinkInvalid: Enter a Google Docs or Google Forms link
createDialog.googleShareHint: The document or form must be shared as “Anyone with the link can view”.
createDialog.importWarningAllAnswersMissing: Google Forms does not share the correct answers — mark them yourself on every question.

importWarning.answerNotDetected: Question {{number}}: the correct answer was not detected — mark it manually
importWarning.notEnoughOptions: Question {{number}}: not enough options — check it
importWarning.unsupportedType: Question {{number}} was not imported: only single and multiple choice questions are supported

preview.regionAria: How the student will see it

attemptDialog.defaultDescription: Answer the questions — no time limit.

attemptsDialog.description: Unlimited retries — each shown in its own row.

editor.formulaHint: The formula is inserted at the cursor
editor.numericHint: Comma or dot are both fine. With tolerance 0 only the exact number is accepted.
editor.textHint: Extra spaces are ignored. Add other valid spellings as separate answers.
editor.matchingHint: Write the pairs correctly — students see the right column shuffled.
editor.orderingHint: Write the items in the correct order — students see them shuffled.
editor.fillBlankHint: Write each blank's answer as {{syntax}}. Separate alternatives with |: {{example}}

answer.multipleHint: You can select more than one answer

editDialog.title: Edit test
editDialog.description: You can change the topic, name and questions.
editDialog.lockedNotice: This test already has attempts — the questions cannot be changed. Only the topic, name and due date are saved.
editDialog.draftNotice: This test is a draft — students cannot see it. Fill in the correct answers and press “Publish”.

groups.title: Question group
groups.hint: Add a group when several questions share one passage or audio.
groups.passagePlaceholder: Passage text (Reading) — the questions belong to it
groups.audioHint: mp3, m4a, aac, ogg, wav · up to {{size}} MB
groups.audioAfterSave: Save the test first to upload audio.
groups.audioTooBig: The file must not exceed {{size}} MB

aiPage.title: New test
aiPage.description: Pick the topic and exam type, upload material if you have it. AI builds a draft test; review it before publishing.
aiPage.fileHint: You can add files one by one: up to 20 MB each, up to 5 files
aiPage.hint: Questions are based on the uploaded material. Scanned (image) PDFs can't be read.
aiPage.fileTooLarge: The file is too large: {{size}} MB (limit {{max}} MB). Choose a smaller file or split out the part you need.
aiPage.countRange: Number of questions must be {{min}} to {{max}}
aiPage.started: Started. You'll get a notification when it's ready.
aiPage.waitHint: This can take a few minutes. It keeps running if you close the page.
aiPage.countHint: If the rules fix the number of questions, they take priority.
aiPage.rulesPlaceholder: E.g. IELTS Reading: 3 passages (700-900 words), 40 questions in total. Passage 1: 6 True/False/Not Given, then 7 gap-fills (no more than 2 words)...
aiPage.rulesHint: You can provide a rules file (PDF, Word...) and/or text. Leave empty for a plain A-B-C-D test.
aiPage.rulesTooLarge: The rules file is too large: {{size}} MB (limit {{max}} MB).
aiPage.tooManyFiles: You can pick at most {{max}} files at once.
aiPage.totalTooLarge: The files together must not exceed {{max}} MB.
aiPage.materialTextPlaceholder: You can copy text from the web and paste it here...
aiPage.materialOptionalHint: Material is optional: if you have none, leave it empty — AI writes the text itself from the topic and rules.
aiPage.examPlaceholder: Type the exam name, e.g. TOEFL iBT Listening
aiPage.examHint: AI knows the official structure of the exam: sections, question types, counts and points are set automatically. If you upload material, it is spread across the sections.
aiPage.rulesToggle: I'll enter the exam rules myself (optional)
aiPage.examSimpleHint: A plain multiple-choice test. You set the number of questions.
aiPage.materialTextToggle: I'll paste the material as text
aiPage.extraToggle: Extra: test name and my own rules (optional)
aiPage.groupHint: The test will be created for this group as a draft. Students see it once you review and publish it.

assignDialog.title: Give a test to a group
assignDialog.description: Give a ready test (for example one made by AI) to a group: students take it in the assignments section.
assignDialog.noQuizzes: There are no ready group-less tests. Create a new one on the AI page.
assignDialog.draftHint: A draft stays hidden from students even after you give it to a group: review and publish it first.
